app.name: MuseHub
app.tagline: A privately deployed development and delivery platform. This build is still an unreleased development preview, not the {{version}} release.
app.deliveryMockNote: Deploy uses compose-mock only (not real OCI / Docker).
app.deliveryModeNote: Deploy follows server policy: pipeline-built OCI + compose-runner when MUSEHUB_REQUIRE_PIPELINE_OCI=1; otherwise compose-mock for local dev.
app.runPipelineOnMain: Run pipeline on merged main tip
app.pipelineCancelPending: Cancel requested — waiting for server/runner to report canceled (in-process runs may finish the current step first).
app.pipelineCancelHonesty: Cancel is a server request only; worker shutdown is confirmed when state becomes canceled, not when this button returns.
app.deploymentListEmpty: No deployments awaiting approval in this repository.
app.deploymentListEmptyAll: No deployments recorded for this repository yet.
app.rollbackNoKnownGood: No succeeded deployment in the loaded list to roll back to — open All history or load more.
app.deploymentListHasMore: More pending deployments exist — refine filters or ask an admin.
app.mergeShortcut: Approve, check, merge (demo; needs CI reporter in real gates)
app.noMergedPr: No merged PR with main tip yet — merge via review + checks first.
